units.source_text: 源氏公子正在推想小姐的人品，他认为这样的性格，比较起过分俏皮而爱出风头的人来，高雅得多。

en.t: Prince Genji was imagining what the young lady must be like, and he felt that this kind of nature was far more refined than that of someone overly playful and eager to attract attention.

units.source_text: 此时小姐被众侍女怂恿着，好容易膝行而前。

en.t: At this moment, urged on by her many gentlewomen, the young lady finally managed to move forward on her knees.

units.source_text: 隔着纸隔扇，公子但觉她沉静温雅，仪态万方，衣香袭人，芬芳可爱，气度好生悠闲！

en.t: Even through the paper screen, the prince sensed how quiet and gracious she was, with elegant bearing, a sweet fragrance clinging to her robes, and a lovely, unhurried dignity.

units.source_text: 他想：“果然不出我之所料。”

en.t: He thought, "She is exactly as I expected."
He was very pleased in his heart.

units.source_text: 他便花言巧语地向她缕述年来相思之苦。

en.t: He then poured out to her, in polished and persuasive words, all the suffering of longing he had endured over the years.

units.source_text: 可是相去如此之近，而全无一句答语。

en.t: Yet although they were so close to one another, she gave not a single word in reply.
The prince thought, "There is truly nothing I can do."
